record.question: What is the definition of Pharmacovigilance?
options: The study that involves detection, assessment, understanding and prevention of adverse drug reactions.
The study that involves the detection, monitoring and investigation of adverse drug reactions.
The study that involves the surveillance and monitoring of adverse drug reactions.
The study that involves the detection of adverse drug reactions of newly launched drugs.
record.explanation: Answer A: The study that involves detection, assessment, understanding and prevention of adverse drug reactions.. WHO defines pharmacovigilance as the science and activities relating to detection, assessment, understanding, and prevention of adverse effects or other medicine-related problems. Reference: https://www.who.int/teams/regulation-prequalification/regulation-and-safety/pharmacovigilance. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
